claims: The Vedder Cup is an annual Major League Baseball rivalry series between the Seattle Mariners and San Diego Padres.
The Vedder Cup was officially established in 2025.
The Vedder Cup was established to honor Eddie Vedder.
Eddie Vedder is the Pearl Jam frontman.
Eddie Vedder has ties to Seattle and San Diego.
The winner of the Vedder Cup receives a custom Fender Telecaster guitar trophy.
The Vedder Cup trophy was designed by Eddie Vedder.
Proceeds from the Vedder Cup support EB Research Partnership.
The Vedder Cup trophy is a customized 1963 Fender Telecaster guitar.
The Vedder Cup trophy is engraved with team logos and the year.
The Vedder Cup formalizes a long-time fan nickname for the interleague matchup between the Seattle Mariners and San Diego Padres.
The Seattle Mariners are defending the inaugural 2025 Vedder Cup title.
2026 Vedder Cup games are scheduled for April 14-16 at Petco Park.
2026 Vedder Cup games are scheduled for May 15-17 at T-Mobile Park.
The Vedder Cup series benefits the Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB) Research Partnership.
Eddie Vedder and Jill Vedder co-founded the EB Research Partnership.
The Seattle Mariners and San Diego Padres are playing in the 2026 Vedder Cup series.
The Seattle Mariners won the first game of the 2026 Vedder Cup series.
Vedder Cup tickets and merchandise information is available via Mariners.com/VedderCup.
Vedder Cup tickets and merchandise information is available via Padres.com/Vedder.
